visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young male character looking upward at glowing, magical-looking purple and orange sparks. He has a look of awe and curiosity, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. The setting appears to be a dimly lit hospital hallway with window blinds in the background. (2) The scene transitions to a medical diagram showing human lungs with text overlays describing pneumothorax. It then cuts to various movie scenes showing characters performing incredible feats, such as counting objects rapidly or playing the piano with intense focus. The backgrounds vary from a bright hospital setting to a darker room with a grand piano. (3) A cartoon avatar with a blue-and-white spherical head and a 'C' logo appears over a black background, looking inquisitive. The video then cuts to a male narrator in a black t-shirt standing in front of a dark backdrop with simple graphics. He gestures with his hands as he speaks directly to the camera. (4) Archival footage of an older man with glasses and thinning hair, Kim Peek, is shown. He is seen reading books extremely fast, flipping pages with his hands while wearing a short-sleeved shirt. Another man is seen talking to him in a library-like setting with bookshelves and a bust of a person. (5) A different segment features Jason Padgett, a middle-aged man with short dark hair and glasses. He is shown in an interview setting and later in a reenactment where he is being attacked on a sidewalk. The scene transitions to show green mathematical grid overlays on trees and street scenes, representing his unique vision. (6) The video concludes with the male narrator returning to the screen to provide final statistics against a dark background with simple bar chart graphics. It ends with a branding screen featuring a circular logo with a cartoon boy's face and the text '維思維' and '訂閱'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 聽起來很酷的學者症候群?. [Logo]: 維思維. (2) [Subtitle]: 在影視作品中主角們像是由超能力一樣. (3) [Subtitle]: 有過目不忘的能力、超長的計算能力、藝術才能等等. (4) [Variety]: 學者症候群. (5) [Slogan]: 現實中真的有嗎?. (6) [Subtitle]: 美國人Kim Peek 先天腦部異常. (7) [Subtitle]: 無法自理但他在25分鐘內讀完十多萬字的小說. (8) [Subtitle]: 他一生讀了約9000本書而且幾乎能記得每一個字. (9) [Subtitle]: 他甚至能說出當天是星期幾. (10) [Subtitle]: 學者症候群患者通常都是天生的. (11) [Subtitle]: 多數智商在40~70 一般大約在100左右. (12) [Subtitle]: 但也有特別的案例 Jason Padgett. (13) [Subtitle]: 我當時也說過「數學很蠢」. (14) [Subtitle]: 搶劫和歐打後他突然看到整個世界都是由複雜的數學圖形組成的. (15) [Subtitle]: 不過要注意的是雖然很多學者症候群都患有自閉症. (16) [Subtitle]: 但其實只有十分之一的自閉症患者有學者症候群的症狀喔. (17) [Logo]: 維思維. [Slogan]: 訂閱 每周來點大小知識.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-tempo electronic BGM characterized by a steady synth pulse. A male narrator's voice is prominent, delivering information in Mandarin with a clear, professional tone and a relatively fast speech rate. A distinct 'pop' sound effect punctuates the transition between the introductory phrase and the start of the explanation. (2) As movie clips play, the narration continues seamlessly, but brief snippets of dialogue from the films (in English) are mixed in at a lower volume. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual cut to the medical diagram. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) A new phase is triggered by a short, high-pitched 'bubble' sound effect as the cartoon character appears. The narrator's tone becomes slightly more inquisitive. The background electronic beat remains constant, providing a rhythmic foundation for the fast-paced speech. (4) The audio transitions to include archival recordings of Kim Peek. His voice is heard speaking in English, with a distinct, slightly muffled timbre characteristic of older recordings. The Mandarin narrator continues to provide a voiceover, with the BGM dipping slightly in volume during Peek's speech fragments. (5) Another transition SFX, a digital 'zip,' introduces the Jason Padgett segment. The audio here includes snippets of an American news interview, where a female reporter's voice is briefly heard. The Mandarin narrator explains the trauma that led to Padgett's savant abilities, maintaining a steady, informative cadence. (6) The final phase features a call to action. The BGM swells slightly in volume as the narrator concludes his explanation. A final 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of the subscription button on the closing screen. The overall audio mix is clean and well-produced.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Definition -> Case Studies -> Conclusion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about Savant Syndrome by contrasting its portrayal in popular media (like 'The Good Doctor' and 'Rain Man') with real-life examples such as Kim Peek and Jason Padgett. It clarifies common misconceptions, such as the relationship between Savant Syndrome and Autism, and explains how the condition can be either innate or acquired through brain injury.
